name: pitch-deck-design-systems
description: One folder per deck style. Each builds ../pitch-deck-<style>.pptx from build.js + theme.json.

scripts.build:all: for s in template liquid-glass terminal-ledger vault-engraving acid-editorial neo-brutal ember-grid daybreak daybreak-silk daybreak-metallic; do node $s/build.js || exit 1; done
